dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: With this endless stream of materials, how will we ever finish the lantern on schedule? *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: I suppose the gods will remember all our hard work building it, though, won't they?

dialogues.speaker: Hammer Li
dialogues.text: When it is finally released... I think I'm going to pray for a Vision!
